title: Glow Sqast with Happy Sqasts
description: Changes Ghasts to look like Glow Squids and Happy Ghasts to look like regular Squids!
body:
This version of Sqast changes Ghasts to look like Glow Squids, but Happy Ghasts to look like regular Squids! So you have have both varients of Sqasts at the same time! :D it also changes the textures for Glow Sqast/Happy Sqast Spawn Eggs, Glow Sqast Tears, "Tears" Music Disc, and the Dried Sqast
![All of the new textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/6NOKT6i8/images/9feeb470db93ad8ea4aff897e6888a9289349ede.png)

Note: In order for Glow Sqasts to actually "glow" (with an emissive texture) you will need a mod like [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) (Entity Texture Features) or [Optifine](https://optifine.net/home). However, I've only tested the pack with ETF, so although it should work with Optifine too, it's not guaranteed that it will.


**This pack will change the names of Ghasts and their related items if your language is set to one of the following:**
- English US,
- English UK,
- German (Deutsch) Thanks to [foenichs](https://modrinth.com/user/foenichs) for helping translate :)
- Pirate Speak,
- LOLCAT,
- Shakespearean English,
- English Upsidedown,
- English Australian,
- English Canadian,
- English New Zealand,
- or Anglish (Oned Riches)
